posts.post:
the best style advice is just wearing the same thing until you stop thinking about how you look. 

confidence is forgetting you’re wearing clothes at all.
everyone claims they want a timeless wardrobe, but half the fun of getting dressed is being wrong about a fit once in a while.

we pushed back a launch because the zipper pull felt two grams too light. 

if you can feel the cost-cutting, it’s not worth wearing.
